title: Q-ULTRA-free-tier-meter-value-UNMEASURED: essential variable free-tier-meter:value cannot be read
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** `free-tier-meter:value` has no fresh reading (source tenant.declared_metric)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation ultrastability --status
**Status:** open

An unmeasured variable is never in bounds and never a reason to change the system. Make the reading (probe, writer or fresh ledger row) so the loop can judge it.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation ultrastability --status` shows `free-tier-meter:value` with a value.
